_about: One row per Bloodborne animation slot of the new movesets. Slot meanings come from the template weapon's own behaviour names (BehaviorParam_PC: R1 1-4 = 30000-30300, running R1/R2 = 32100/32150, rolling = 32200/32230/32240, jump = 32300, backstep R1/R2 = 32500/32550, R2 tap = 32620, R2 held = 32630, held again = 32660, transform = 33300/33310; +10000 for the buffed form, 46000 = L2). Creator 2026-11-10: map the moves the way Lies of P does: R1 = the Pale Knight's light combo (NA), R2 = its heavy combo (SA, gun shots), held R2 = its charged attacks (CA), with the charge dash (CA4) on held R2. The slot's events (hits, cancels, sounds) come from the template slot, re-timed onto the Lies of P montage's own marks. shotFrom: adds that template slot's attack (42300, seen firing in 0.2.7) at every LProjectile mark of the Lies of P move, so shots fire where Lies of P fires; stripHits drops the template's melee hits first (pure shots). hitsFrom: replaces the hits with another slot's (Full Salvo fires the charged blast). Lies of P montage paths are under LiesofP/Content/ArtAsset/CH/PC/Pino/Animset/. 'verified' = seen working in the running game. fxFrom (e.g. a104:41000, the Rifle Spear's gun shot): that slot's bullet, muzzle flash and weapon sounds at every fire mark of the Lies of P move. clipStart/clipEnd: seconds of the montage to use (0 = whole). fxDummy: the Pale Knight model point the borrowed gun flash sits on (100 = blade tip, so the blast leaves the end of the blade; the Rifle Spear's own point would be the empty sheath slot, which is why no flash showed in 0.3.2). Idle transform (creator 2026-11-10, 0.3.2 test: standing/moving L1 didn't transform): no shared-move rows any more; the control script sends the Pale Knight's L1 transform to the combo-transform move (systems sheet pk-idle-transform). 0.3.5 (creator's 0.3.4 test): mode-A gun moves fire the proven 42300 shot (shotFrom) and borrow only the Rifle Spear's flash and sound (fxFrom no longer brings its bullet, which never fired); charge start back to CA4 [0-0.55] and loop [0.45-0.55] as in 0.3.2, when held R2 worked. 0.3.6: slots that play another template slot outright (ImportOtherAnim, e.g. dodge attacks 32210 = 32200, 32220 = 32240) now play that slot's Lies of P move, and every variant of a row gets the row's shots, flash, sound and buffs (0.3.5 short R2 had none because the game played its variant). shotDummy (0.3.6 test: untransformed R2 and transformed L2 still fired nothing): the launch point written into the borrowed shot (TAE 318 first value). The template's 42300 shot says 1, which works only in the transformed form of the Moonlight Sword; the shots that fired in 0.3.4 named a blade point (12130). Normal-form shots: 10100 (blade tip of the normal-form part), L2: 12100 (tip of the transformed part); 0 = keep. Recovery: the template's first lasting control flag after its hits is now placed at Lies of P's first ApplyInput_ mark after the hit (Retime second anchor). blastJudge (0.3.8): a hit with that behaviour judge (shots sheet blast: from the blade tip out 4.5 m) at every Lies of P fire mark; used by the untransformed shot moves, because Bloodborne only fires right-hand projectiles in the transformed form. rootScale (0.3.9): multiplies the Lies of P move's forward travel (1 = as in Lies of P). stripShots: drops the template slot's own projectile events (318) before shotFrom adds its shot. shotJudge (0.3.10): the behaviour judge written into the added shot (0 = the shot slot's own), e.g. 970 = the cannonball. 0.3.11: fxFrom with shotJudge (and no shotFrom/blastJudge) keeps the borrowed gun's own projectile event with that judge, e.g. a129:51000 + 980 = the Cataclysm's R2 follow-up shot from the left arm. bulletCost (0.3.18): every shot the move fires also fires the bullet-use event (shots sheet bulletCost), so it costs 1 Quicksilver Bullet; L2 has its own already. 0.3.19: bulletCost off again (creator 0.3.18 test: shots cost 3 either way; the cost is the left-hand gun's bulletConsumeNum, so the Cataclysm now uses 1). shotOnly (0.3.23): shotFrom adds only the projectile, not the source slot's own blade hit (the transformed hit 551 has no hit points on the untransformed blade). hitTime (2026-11-18): seconds into the (clipped) Lies of P move where the template's first hit or shot lands, for moves with no hit mark (-1 = none). trailFxFrom / trailFxPoints / trailFxTail (2026-11-18): another weapon slot's effects and swing sounds around its first hit (e.g. a145:40000, the Boom Hammer's transformed R1 fire), moved onto this move's first blade hit with the same lead time; weapon points become trailFxPoints (full ids, in the order the source's distinct weapon points appear); they end trailFxTail seconds after the hit ends. newSlot (2026-11-18): a slot the template doesn't have, built from templateAnimId's family (+2/+3/+5 variants and the +10 buffed ones). selectorFrom: the behaviour's manual selectors (name pattern) that move from the template slot family to this row's, for every gun they hold (see systems cat-side-dodge-fire). fxOnly (2026-11-19): fxFrom brings only the borrowed gun's flash and sounds, never its projectile. fxDummy of 10000 or more is a full model point id (12100 = tip of the transformed part).
